rationale: The sign-safe accruals gate is a legitimate repair of the archive's best signal, but the hypothesis mislabels an EBITDA (accrual) yield as an "operating-cash yield," and changing both the denominator (EV) and the quality leg at once will make attribution of any alpha change ambiguous.

Both legs are individually well-known anomalies (sales-to-price, cash-flow accruals), but the sales-scaled, sign-safe quality gate paired with an earnings-free valuation anchor is a coherent and genuinely diagnostic test of whether the gen-1 alpha came from the quality gate or the EBITDA-yield pairing.

(pi - ib) is total tax expense including deferred taxes, so it neither measures cash taxes paid nor book-tax differences as the hypothesis claims, and as the reasoning itself concedes it is mechanically a profitability/tax-rate proxy — leaving the signal a near-duplicate of the archive's already-tested earnings-yield × profitability interactions.

The cash-netted denominator (mktcap − che) can be small or negative precisely for the cash-rich firms the hypothesis targets, producing explosive and sign-inverted yields that winsorizing cannot fix — the exact defect the first proposal claims to eliminate — and the surviving content is again value × profitability.

Substituting a downside-only loss-frequency gate for the failed symmetric volatility gate is an economically motivated, non-cosmetic change, though the unnormalized 0–5 count is heavily massed at 5 and multiplies the signal to exactly zero for all loss-prone firms, creating a large uninformative tie block that will blunt the sort.

Because non-payers all receive the same tied dividend-yield rank, the product's ordering within that large block is driven purely by (oibdp − dvc)/at — which is itself essentially operating profitability since dvc/at is negligible — so the signal collapses toward a plain profitability sort plus a well-known dividend-yield tilt rather than the claimed payout-sustainability gate.
